context: Hi! I'm here to help you chose a movie!
Terrific
What are some genres you like? What was the last movie you saw?
the last movie i saw in the theater was 'Hustlers' . I generally like comedy, drama and documentaries
How did you like 'Hustlers'? It definitely has the drama aspect, did it leave you wanting more or was it not exactly what you were looking for?
I liked it,  it wasn't the most high-brow movie i've ever seen but it was fun. I like to just enjoy
And what are your thoughts on action in film?
I like some action. Just not too violent
Definitely, movies like 'Deadpool' wouldn't be up your alley I'm guessing?
It could be. I understand Deadpool was very funny  I like funny
Haha it definitely was, I think I have a suggestion for you though
Cool  Whats that?

So it's the new'A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood', the Mr. Rogers movie with Tom Hanks as the actor. It's not as much a comedic relief, but I saw it in theatres with my roomates and it's honestly a super refreshing and incredibly well directed movie.
that sounds so good to me. I loved Mr. Rogers so much.. and Tom Hanks is a great actor
The combination is incredible to be honest, and it lets you understand his background and who he was as a person so much more
That sounds amazing. I would love to see that
Awesome, that's my recommendation then!
Great! That is totally what i'm going to see. I can't wait to watch the trailer
The trailer's awesome and it's even better in theater
Well then. Given the opportunity I will formally accept. Thank you so much for your help
entity: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood (2019)

context.content: Hi there! What kind of movies do you usually enjoy?
Hey! I'm into comedies mostly. Something that can make me laugh and maybe think a bit too.
That sounds great! Have you seen "My Favorite Year" (1982)? It's a classic comedy about a struggling actor who gets a chance to star in a Broadway show.
"My Favorite Year"? Sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about it?
It's a heartwarming comedy about an actor's journey and the people he meets along the way. The performances are fantastic, and it has plenty of laughs and moments of genuine emotion.
Sounds like it could be a good fit. What's the plot about specifically? I want to make sure it's something I'd enjoy.

It follows an actor named Sidney Bruhl who's having trouble getting work. He gets a role in a Broadway show but soon realizes he needs to improve his acting skills. Along the way, he forms a bond with a young writer and helps her find her voice. It's a delightful mix of humor and character development.
That sounds perfect! I love stories where characters grow and develop. And the idea of an actor improving their craft seems right up my alley. [END]

entity: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood (2019)
